lines.text: When a million Persian warriors demanded Greece surrender her weapons, King Leonidas answered: Molon Labe â€” Come and take them.
At the narrow pass of Thermopylae, three hundred elite Spartans locked bronze shields into an impenetrable wall of iron spears.
Wave after wave of Xerxes' elite Immortals charged into the chokepoint, only to be shattered against the disciplined Spartan line.
For two days the Greeks stood unbroken, until a local traitor named Ephialtes revealed a secret mountain path around the pass.
Surrounded on all sides, Leonidas and his men fought to the last broken spear, buying Athens time to prepare victory at sea.
Go tell the Spartans, stranger passing by, that here obedient to their laws we lie. Subscribe to Beyond History for more.
